tool_args.rationale: The monotone, concave pilot supports the square-root siphon as a candidate, but its narrow gradient span leaves the sink strength poorly identified. The 2.0-cost probe adds gradient leverage so vmax and rho can be fitted over the full fallback bounds rather than forcing rho into the narrow warm-start interval.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the square-root siphon on the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The 0.018 gradient span identifies the effective amplitude near s_grad = 1 much better than vmax and rho separately. A good pilot fit could still miss the tolerance at other gradients.
The pilot already samples the target horizon. Wider gradient coverage addresses the unresolved parameter tradeoff more directly and costs less.
